coverage.method: Manual source review against all 34 parts and all 11 Part 21 strategy families, plus AST parameter-use inventory. Feature availability is not proof of learned strategy behavior or economic value.

strategies.assessment: MA ratios, slopes and trend strength exist; no standalone MA trend strategy or live trend rule.
SMA fast=5/slow=20 features; no explicit crossover entry/exit baseline; EMA not implemented.
Returns at 1/5/10/20/30 ticks and a ret_5 > 0 long/flat baseline. Live ML can consume features; directional behavior and added value unverified.
20-tick z-score, z-score change, reversal return; backtest long below -1.5/short above +1.5. Live cannot execute the short baseline or exits.
20-tick simple rolling RSI feature; no 30/70 strategy rule. Zero-loss case becomes NaN, including uninterrupted gains.
20-tick, 2-standard-deviation band position; no dedicated band entry/exit rule.
No prior-range highs/lows, channel break or breakout entry/exit baseline.
Realized volatility exists as context/sizing input; no return-versus-volatility breakout trigger.
Raw ticker trade-value fields retained, but no relative-volume, volume-change, volume-z-score or confirmation strategy. Raw fields reaching ML is not a defined volume strategy.
5-tick ranks/percentiles and relative returns; baseline thresholds 0.7/0.3. No portfolio basket construction, balanced long/short execution or freshness control.
Averaged momentum/z-score baseline and classifier feature combination exist. Independent contribution, probability calibration and portfolio P&L diversification are untested.

handbook_sections.title: PART 1 — WHAT ALGORITHMIC TRADING ACTUALLY IS
handbook_sections.assessment: Modular pipeline present, but desired exposure is not converted into reconciled orders.

handbook_sections.title: PART 2 — BASIC MARKET AND CRYPTO TRADING CONCEPTS
handbook_sections.assessment: Ticker/order interfaces present; venue conventions and actual short execution remain unverified.

handbook_sections.title: PART 3 — PRICE DATA AND MARKET DATA
handbook_sections.assessment: Sorting and forward filling present; no duplicate, gap, age or schema protection.

handbook_sections.title: PART 4 — STATISTICS EVERY ALGORITHMIC TRADER SHOULD KNOW
handbook_sections.assessment: Returns, volatility and basic metrics exist; probability is incorrectly treated as expected return.

handbook_sections.title: PART 5 — PROBABILITY AND STATISTICAL THINKING
handbook_sections.assessment: No uncertainty intervals, trial accounting or multiple-testing safeguards.

handbook_sections.title: PART 6 — TIME SERIES BASICS
handbook_sections.assessment: Rolling returns and volatility exist; no stationarity or autocorrelation research.

handbook_sections.title: PART 7 — FEATURES AND INDICATORS
handbook_sections.assessment: Returns/SMA/z-score/RSI/Bollinger/ranks/volatility implemented; no EMA, ATR, MACD, stochastic, VWAP or derived volume features.

handbook_sections.title: PART 8 — SIGNAL GENERATION
handbook_sections.assessment: Several threshold baselines exist; no shared signed strategy interface for live use.

handbook_sections.title: PART 9 — POSITION SIZING
handbook_sections.assessment: Per-asset confidence/volatility sizing exists; capital fraction sent as asset quantity.

handbook_sections.title: PART 10 — LONG/SHORT STRATEGIES
handbook_sections.assessment: Backtest supports negative weights and short API wrappers exist; live cannot sell, short or close positions.

handbook_sections.title: PART 11 — BACKTESTING
handbook_sections.assessment: Vectorized single-asset simulator exists; fee/drawdown defects, no fill ledger or reconciled cash/portfolio accounting.

handbook_sections.title: PART 12 — HOW TO ACCIDENTALLY FAKE A PROFITABLE STRATEGY
handbook_sections.assessment: Features pass prefix invariance on fixtures, but leakage guard is vacuous and forward labels cross validation boundaries.

handbook_sections.title: PART 13 — TRAINING / VALIDATION / TESTING
handbook_sections.assessment: Chronological rolling splits exist; no horizon purge or separately locked final test period.

handbook_sections.title: PART 14 — OVERFITTING
handbook_sections.assessment: Train-validation accuracy gap recorded; no parameter stability or held-out evidence.

handbook_sections.title: PART 15 — ROBUSTNESS TESTING
handbook_sections.assessment: No parameter, cost, asset, period, delay or outage robustness research harness.

handbook_sections.title: PART 16 — PERFORMANCE METRICS
handbook_sections.assessment: Basic metrics exist but drawdown/terminal fees/Sortino edge cases fail; win rate is per bar, not per closed trade.

handbook_sections.title: PART 17 — TRANSACTION COSTS AND EXECUTION
handbook_sections.assessment: Fixed fee/slippage assumptions and turnover charges exist; probability edge proxy invalid, no dynamic spread or realized fill costs.

handbook_sections.title: PART 18 — MARKET MICROSTRUCTURE
handbook_sections.assessment: Bid/ask collected but not used for fills, spread gates or execution timing.

handbook_sections.title: PART 19 — RISK MANAGEMENT
handbook_sections.assessment: Per-asset sizing active; portfolio cap, drawdown kill switch and hourly order limit not enforced in live loop. No daily loss/correlation caps.

handbook_sections.title: PART 20 — PORTFOLIO CONSTRUCTION
handbook_sections.assessment: Positive allocation cap helper exists; signed gross limit wrong and helper not integrated. No correlated cluster controls or portfolio backtest.

handbook_sections.title: PART 21 — STRATEGY IDEAS FOR A BEGINNER
handbook_sections.assessment: Three explicit strategy baselines, several feature families, three missing/raw-only families; no validation evidence supplied.

handbook_sections.title: PART 22 — COMBINING STRATEGIES
handbook_sections.assessment: Rule averaging and ML combinations exist; ablation confounds model change with regime contribution, component flags incompletely wired.

handbook_sections.title: PART 23 — MACHINE LEARNING
handbook_sections.assessment: Three classifiers implemented; no scaler/calibration/schema artifact, horizon purge or known-label masking for classifiers. Regression target has no regressor.

handbook_sections.title: PART 24 — REINFORCEMENT LEARNING
handbook_sections.assessment: Reinforcement learning absent; handbook describes it as generally unnecessary for this beginner setting.

handbook_sections.title: PART 25 — BOT ARCHITECTURE
handbook_sections.assessment: Modules separated; no trained-model loading, authoritative portfolio state, order delta or fill reconciliation. Service package path invalid in documented checkout.

handbook_sections.title: PART 26 — LIVE TRADING VS BACKTESTING
handbook_sections.assessment: Retry/logging/service restart exist; ambiguous order POSTs retried blindly, no centralized limiter, stale-data halt or partial-fill reconciliation.

handbook_sections.title: PART 27 — PAPER TRADING / DRY RUN
handbook_sections.assessment: DRY_RUN suppresses orders; no paper cash/positions/fills/P&L or demonstrated live-backtest parity.

handbook_sections.title: PART 28 — LOGGING AND DEBUGGING
handbook_sections.assessment: Console signal/API error logging present; no structured position/fill/fee/P&L event ledger.

handbook_sections.title: PART 29 — SOFTWARE ENGINEERING PRACTICES
handbook_sections.assessment: Config/modules/gitignore/seed present; no supplied offline tests, package metadata or saved data/model manifests. This audit adds checks only.

handbook_sections.title: PART 30 — EXPERIMENTATION WORKFLOW
handbook_sections.assessment: Baseline comparison scaffold exists; no experiment records, fair common out-of-sample window or final holdout evidence.

handbook_sections.title: PART 31 — HOW TO CONDUCT A GOOD TRADING EXPERIMENT
handbook_sections.assessment: No frozen hypothesis/data/config/cost records or rejected-experiment log.

handbook_sections.title: PART 32 — 20 THINGS THAT WILL PROBABLY GO WRONG IN YOUR FIRST TRADING BOT
handbook_sections.assessment: Several listed first-bot pitfalls reproduced by this audit; see individual contract results.

handbook_sections.title: PART 33 — HACKATHON STRATEGY
handbook_sections.assessment: Team responsibilities, staged research and fallback operation are process choices; deployment instructions alone do not demonstrate readiness.

handbook_sections.title: PART 34 — FINAL CHEAT SHEET
handbook_sections.assessment: Some essential formulas implemented; final trust questions remain unresolved without repaired accounting and out-of-sample/robustness evidence.
